title: Robichaux's band at the Lyric and closing
summary: He recalls Professor Robichaux as left-handed violinist leading the band with Black Benny, Red Happy and Kimball; the reel ends.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: What do we have, a minute or two? Yeah, a couple of minutes.
Well, who was the leader of the band?
Yeah, a couple of minutes. Oh man, Professor Joe Robeshow. Is that the...
I think it's Joe or John Robeshow.

Well, he was the leader of the band then. Left handed violin. Yeah. Is he related to the Joe that played... Joe Robeshow that played piano with us, yeah. I think that's his uncle. Mm-hmm. I see. Oh, yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
You remember who was in Robichaux's band at the Liried?
No, the only two I remember was Black, three rather, was Black Benny, Red Happy, and Kimball, trumpet player. I mean he was their trumpet player too, believe me.
Well who came first, Black Benny or Red Happy?
No, Red Happy and then Black Benny.
I think that's the end of it now.
